verdict.rationale: The Gmail API scopes documentation tells developers to pick the narrowest possible scope and to avoid requesting unneeded ones. It also points to non-sensitive scopes that limit access to specific features [gmail-docs-4, gmail-docs-29], and read-only extraction is a documented use case [gmail-docs-17]. Together these give an agent a least-privilege credential path. Missing for 10: documentation of the actual credential issuance and revocation flow (OAuth client or token creation), any agent-specific or per-agent credential management, a scope catalog in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
